latestVersion.changelog:
Initial public release of claw-browser-automation.

- Fast Rust-based CLI for headless browser automation with Node.js fallback.
- Supports navigation, clicking, typing, form filling, snapshots, screenshots, video, and more via structured commands.
- Includes powerful selectors: refs, roles, text, labels, and CSS.
- Enables programmatic web UI testing, data extraction, and automation from the terminal.
- Comprehensive CLI command set for browser control, interaction, and state management.
